source_title: Canadian Pacific Kansas City Limited declares dividend - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
CALGARY, AB , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Board of Directors of Canadian Pacific Kansas City Limited (TSX: CP) (NYSE: CP ) (CPKC) today declared a quarterly dividend of $0.268 per share on the outstanding Common Shares.
The dividend is payable on January 25, 2027, to holders of record at the close of business on December 31, 2026, and is an "eligible" dividend for purposes of the Income Tax Act (Canada) and any similar provincial/territorial legislation.
